question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

I particular like that kitten because it has white feet.
solution:
The correct answer is** ****'****I particular like that kitten because it has white feet. '**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the part** "I particular like."**
 
• The correct expression is** "I particularly like,**" with "particularly" being an **adverb modifying** the verb** "like."**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: ***'******I particularly like** that kitten because it has white feet. '*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not contain any grammatical errors.
